question.message:
Nothing is saved yet. On `approve all` the case is set with the values the brief and the two demand files state (time axis 2027-01-01 to 2028-01-01 daily; both demand series from the CSVs; heating supply 100 degC and cooling supply 20 degC; reservoir 2500 m / 100 m / 200 mD / 250 bar(g); gradient 30 degC/km; surface 12 degC; brine 1030 kg/m3, 0.4 mPa.s, GLR 0.8 Nm3/m3, produced gas 80 mol% CH4 / 20 mol% CO2; 8 requirements) PLUS the following values, which no project file gives. Each is from the case's assumptions document in Knowledge (knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md, section "Case values" / "Requirements: tolerances the PDF does not give") unless marked otherwise:

1. time_zone of both demand series = UTC | agent assumption, no source | the brief names no site location and the dates carry no offset; gemini refuses a series without a zone, and gemini's sample uses UTC timestamps.
2. demand.heating.return_temperature = 60 degC | knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md, "Case values" | team design choice, below the fixed 100 degC supply.
3. demand.heating.return_pressure = 6 bar | same document | team value.
4. demand.cooling.return_temperature = 25 degC | same document | team design choice, above the fixed 20 degC supply.
5. demand.cooling.return_pressure = 4 bar | same document | team value.
6. demand.cooling.dew_point_margin = 1 K | same document | team value.
7. demand.cooling.indoor_temperature = 26 degC | same document | team value.
8. demand.cooling.indoor_relative_humidity = 50 % (0.5) | same document | team value.
9. site.air.temperature = 10 degC, constant | same document | team value; no site location is given, so no weather series can be fetched.
10. site.air.pressure = 101325 Pa, constant | same document | team value.
11. site.fluid.sand_concentration = 20 mg/l | same document | team value.
12. utilities.electricity.co2_intensity = 300 g/kWh | same document, "Organisers" | the organisers' answer on Discord #technical-q-and-a, 2026-11-04.
13. utilities.gas.composition (bought grid gas, mole fractions) = CH4 0.8249507401227822, C2H6 0.039549858193534584, C3H8 0.012748086337494389, CO2 0.011912342910726407, N2 0.11083897243546233 | same document | team value; this is the bought gas, not the produced gas.
14. requirements.full_reinjection: reinjection_ratio 0.99999 to 1.00001, per doublet, each running step | same document, "Requirements: tolerances" | the brief requires equal production and injection volumes but gives no tolerance.
15. requirements.heat_delivered: unmet_share of the yearly heat demand at most 0.01 (1 %) | same document | the brief requires the demand be met but gives no tolerance.
16. requirements.cold_delivered: unmet_share of the yearly cold demand at most 0.01 (1 %) | same document | as above.

Left open, not asked (the assumptions document marks them "not set, not needed"): site.air.relative_humidity and utilities.gas.heating_value. Also left unset because gemini derives them: site.reservoir.temperature. The well depth and the number of doublets are design freedoms, not case values.

Do you approve these?

answer.reason: Change: demand.heating.return_temperature = 55 °C instead of 60. Everything else as you have it.
